name: SET binding protein 1

function.text: SETBP1 encodes SET-binding protein. Annotated molecular activities include histone H3K4 methyltransferase activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Schinzel-Giedion midface retraction syndrome (autosomal dominant); complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include MDS/MPN with neutrophilia; Chronic neutrophilic leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
